mapper.insert: insert into abr_partner_commission (referrer_id, referral_id, lead_id, order_id, order_no, product_name, currency, order_amount, rate, commission_amount, order_paid_time, settle_month, status, create_by, create_time) select distinct on (o.order_id) f.referrer_id, r.referral_id, o.lead_id, o.order_id, o.order_no, o.product_name, o.currency, o.amount, coalesce(f.commission_rate, #{defaultRate}), round(o.amount * coalesce(f.commission_rate, #{defaultRate}) / 100, 2), o.paid_time, to_char(o.paid_time, 'YYYY-MM'), 'pending', #{operator}, now() from abr_order o join abr_referral r on r.status <> 'invalid' and (r.lead_id = o.lead_id or exists (select 1 from abr_lead l where (l.lead_id = o.lead_id or l.merged_into = o.lead_id) and (l.lead_id = r.lead_id or l.visitor_id = r.visitor_id or (l.app_user_id is not null and l.app_user_id = r.app_user_id)))) join abr_referrer f on f.referrer_id = r.referrer_id and f.referrer_type = 'partner' where o.status = 'paid' and o.paid_time is not null and o.paid_time >= r.create_time and o.paid_time <= r.create_time + make_interval(days => coalesce(f.window_days, #{defaultWindow})) and coalesce(f.commission_rate, #{defaultRate}) > 0 and not exists (select 1 from abr_partner_commission c where c.order_id = o.order_id) order by o.order_id, r.create_time on conflict (order_id) do nothing
mapper.update: update abr_partner_commission c set status = 'void', void_reason = case when o.status = 'refunded' then '订单已退款' else '订单已取消' end, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = now() from abr_order o where o.order_id = c.order_id and o.status in ('refunded', 'cancelled') and c.status in ('pending', 'confirmed')

update abr_partner_commission c set refund_flag = 'Y', update_by = #{operator}, update_time = now() from abr_order o where o.order_id = c.order_id and o.status = 'refunded' and c.status = 'paid' and c.refund_flag = 'N'
mapper.sql: select c.commission_id, c.referrer_id, f.display_name as referrer_name, f.ref_code, c.referral_id, c.lead_id, l.display_name as lead_name, c.order_id, c.order_no, c.product_name, c.currency, c.order_amount, c.rate, c.commission_amount, c.order_paid_time, c.settle_month, c.status, c.refund_flag, c.void_reason, c.confirm_by, c.confirm_time, c.paid_by, c.paid_time, c.paid_note, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, c.remark from abr_partner_commission c join abr_referrer f on f.referrer_id = c.referrer_id left join abr_lead l on l.lead_id = c.lead_id
mapper.update: update abr_partner_commission set status = 'confirmed', confirm_by = #{operator}, confirm_time = now(), update_by = #{operator}, update_time = now() where status = 'pending' and commission_id in #{id}

update abr_partner_commission set status = 'paid', paid_by = #{operator}, paid_time = now(), paid_note = #{note}, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = now() where status = 'confirmed' and commission_id in #{id}
update abr_partner_commission set status = 'void', void_reason = #{reason}, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = now() where commission_id = #{id} and status in ('pending', 'confirmed')

update abr_partner_commission set refund_flag = 'D', paid_note = concat(paid_note, case when paid_note = '' then '' else '；' end, '退款处理：', #{note}), update_by = #{operator}, update_time = now() where commission_id = #{id} and refund_flag = 'Y'
mapper.select: select f.referrer_id, f.display_name as referrer_name, f.ref_code, c.currency, count(*) filter (where c.status <> 'void') as orders, coalesce(sum(c.order_amount) filter (where c.status <> 'void'), 0) as order_amount, coalesce(sum(c.commission_amount) filter (where c.status <> 'void'), 0) as commission_amount, coalesce(sum(c.commission_amount) filter (where c.status = 'pending'), 0) as pending_amount, coalesce(sum(c.commission_amount) filter (where c.status = 'confirmed'), 0) as confirmed_amount, coalesce(sum(c.commission_amount) filter (where c.status = 'paid'), 0) as paid_amount, count(*) filter (where c.status = 'void') as void_count, count(*) filter (where c.refund_flag = 'Y') as refund_flags from abr_partner_commission c join abr_referrer f on f.referrer_id = c.referrer_id where c.settle_month = #{month} group by f.referrer_id, f.display_name, f.ref_code, c.currency order by commission_amount desc, f.referrer_id
